remarks: Dive into the extraordinary at The RiverHouse! Immerse yourself in a world of casual luxury living in this breathtaking boutique home right on the water, where vibrant in-town living comes alive like never before. Imagine yourself aboard a boat, basking in the tranquility of your massive private covered porch-your personal sanctuary!   Meet the charming swans, Romeo and Juliet, who nest just below and just welcomed their adorable cygnets. Connect with the beauty of nature and recharge your spirit in this picturesque setting. Picture calling this stunning, pet-friendly, fully renovated cape your home, where every detail has been crafted with your comfort and enjoyment in mind.   This luxury apartment is overflowing with features: generous closet space, custom cabinetry, high-end appliances, and the ultimate convenience of an in-unit washer and dryer!   Every window offers breathtaking water views that will inspire and delight you.   Step outside and find yourself just moments away from captivating restaurants, trendy shops, and exciting entertainment options-all at your fingertips. Ditch the car and dive into the vibrant community that surrounds you. And let's not forget the added perk of garage parking! This beautifully renovated historic building beckons you to indulge in a lifestyle filled with luxury, inspiration, and endless possibilities. Don't let this incredible opportunity slip away!
